opinion.summary: Patch correctly fixes the reversed-operand root cause (0.25 vs 4.0 for [3,5,+,2,/]) by changing op(token,a,b) to op(token,b,a) with op defined as a op b, and public test now passes. hypotheses.note: 0.25 == 4.0 is exactly b/a vs a/b inversion for (3+5)/2 vs 2/(3+5); matches operand-swap bug in RPN non-commutative ops.
